opportunities.name: Postgraduate Scholarship (PGS)
eligibility_clues: Full-time PhD and MPhil students, apart from HKU-PS and HKPFS awardees
Normally a first degree with second-class honours first division (or equivalent) or above; Master's results may also be considered
FAQ also says a first degree at second class honours upper division (or equivalent) or above
Subject to availability of funding, during the normative study period
Payments are made on a monthly basis
Apply by indicating Postgraduate Scholarship on the MPhil/PhD admission form; no separate form
Department of Mathematics: applicants need to check Yes for Postgraduate Studentship
Mathematics MPhil/PhD areas include scientific computing, mathematical modelling, and operational research
opportunities.amount_note: A PGS holder whose PhD probationary candidature has been confirmed receives a higher PGS rate (HK$19,655, wef 1/9/2026) from the following calendar month. The Faculty of Science page prints the same two rates.
opportunities.deadline_note: The PGS page does not print a deadline. Applications are made with MPhil and PhD admission. For 2027/28 admission the Main Round is 1 September 2026 – 1 December 2026 (HKT 23:59, GMT+8); 1st Clearing Round 2 December 2026 – 30 April 2027 (HKT 23:59, GMT+8); 2nd Clearing Round 1 May 2027 – 31 August 2027 (HKT 23:59, GMT+8).
opportunities.match_rationale: University-wide monthly postgraduate scholarship for full-time PhD and MPhil, with no local-student exclusion. The Department of Mathematics tells applicants to tick Postgraduate Studentship, and computational mathematics sits in that department. The printed rate takes effect 1/9/2026, during the open 2027/28 admission round.
opportunities.intake_relevance: Rate effective 1/9/2026. Admission applications for 2027/28 are open; PGS is requested on that application.
restrictions: Not the package paid to HKU-PS and HKPFS awardees
Subject to funding and satisfactory progress
Holder may be required to provide up to 100 hours of departmental training in a twelve-month period

opportunities.name: Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme (HKPFS)
eligibility_clues: New applicants to full-time PhD programmes in government-funded institutions
Irrespective of country of origin and ethnic background
Outstanding academic performance, research ability or potential, communication and interpersonal skills, and leadership abilities
Around 300 fellowships awarded by the RGC each academic year
HKU applicants must state HKU as the first choice in the RGC system
For the 2027/28 exercise, all HKPFS holders will be awarded the HKU Presidential PhD Scholarship
Department of Mathematics: check Yes for HKPF Scheme and complete the RGC initial application
opportunities.amount_note: Postgraduate Scholarship of HK$28,700 per month and conference and research-related travel allowance of HK$14,400 per year for up to three years. HKU provides the same support in the fourth year of a 4-year PhD. On top, the 2027/28 HKU-PS top-up includes a cash award of HK$40,000 in Year 1 and HK$20,000 per year in the remaining normative study period, and a waiver of composition fees (i.e. HK$49,500 per year).
opportunities.deadline_note: Step 1: RGC initial application on or before December 1, 2026 at 12:00 noon, Hong Kong Time (GMT +8 hours). Step 2: full HKU application, indicating HKPFS and quoting the HKPFS Reference Number, on or before December 1, 2026.
opportunities.match_rationale: Explicit 2027/28 full-time PhD fellowship that pays a monthly postgraduate scholarship. Local students are eligible because the scheme is irrespective of country of origin. Mathematics is not excluded, and the department lists HKPF on its admission page.
opportunities.intake_relevance: Fellowship Awards for 2027/28 Admission.
restrictions: Only one HKPFS award if successful
Choice of programmes, departments, and universities cannot be amended after the RGC deadline
Declining the first-choice institution does not transfer the offer to the second choice
Science FAQ: HKPF cannot be concurrently held with the standard PGS package

opportunities.name: HKU Presidential PhD Scholar Programme (HKU-PS Programme)
eligibility_clues: Selected outstanding full-time PhD students
All applicants applying for the full-time PhD programme will be considered
The brightest candidates who are passionate about research
Shortlisted candidates may be invited to attend an interview
Main Round applicants are strongly encouraged to apply also for HKPFS
Department of Mathematics: candidates are selected by the University based on academic and/or research achievements
opportunities.amount_note: Package of up to around HK$445,800 (US$57,150) in the first year and up to around HK$428,300 (US$54,920) in each subsequent year of the normative study period. Includes cash award HK$40,000 in Year 1 and HK$20,000 per year thereafter, waiver of composition fees (i.e. HK$49,500 per year), Postgraduate Scholarship of HK$28,700 per month, and conference and research-related travel allowance of HK$14,400 per year.
opportunities.deadline_note: The programme page prints the Main Round as 1 September – 1 December and does not put a year on that line. The application-period page states the 2027/28 Main Round as 1 September 2026 – 1 December 2026 (HKT 23:59, GMT+8). Applications are invited all year round, with clearing rounds only if vacancies remain.
opportunities.match_rationale: The 2027/28 package includes a monthly postgraduate scholarship for full-time PhD study, and every full-time PhD applicant is considered, with no local-student bar. It is university-wide and the Department of Mathematics lists it.
opportunities.intake_relevance: Scholarship Package for 2027/28 Admission.
restrictions: Science FAQ: HKU-PS cannot be concurrently held with the standard PGS package
FAQ: all HKU HKPFS holders are awarded HKU-PS
